title: Zesty French Almond Roast
description: A nutty, juicy snack that blends French flavors with cumin and lemon for a sugar‑free, nostalgic treat.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375F (190C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Rinse the almonds and pat them dry with a paper towel.
In a medium bowl, toss the almonds with olive oil, cumin, smoked paprika, sea salt, and black pepper until coated.
Spread the coated almonds in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet.
Roast the almonds in the preheated oven for 12 to 15 minutes, stirring once halfway through, until golden brown and aromatic.
Remove the almonds from the oven and let them cool for about 5 minutes, then sprinkle chopped fresh parsley over them.
Toss the warm almonds gently to coat with parsley, and transfer to a serving bowl.
Enjoy the zesty, nutty almonds as a satisfying snack or store leftovers in an airtight container for up to a week.
